purpose: Build a phase-based feature family that is NOT derived from second-order statistics, then test whether it transfers across sessions better than correlation-logSPD. Rationale: every view tried so far (logSPD, Fisher correlations, covariance, DINOv2 image embeddings) is a function of the covariance matrix, and the cross-session instability lives exactly there. Phase-amplitude coupling (PAC), weighted phase lag index (wPLI), spectral entropy and Hjorth parameters do not require a stable covariance.
